verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution offers chat-based, LLM-generated suggestions on root cause and how to fix errors. Nothing in the pack shows the AI drafting a code change or opening a pull request against a connected repo for review. The GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab integrations are documented only for repo connection and source map decoding, so the PR-opening core of the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review
